scope.selection_rule: All and only the expected-document disagreements recorded in comparison_a.json.

decisions_applied.exact_meaning: A broadly related route is inaccurate when it does not preserve the requested source, object or effect.
decisions_applied.full_compound_outside_registry: If an indispensable clause is outside the frozen registry, the whole request is unrepresentable/outside_registry; no partial executable subgraph is retained as gold.
decisions_applied.producer_count: A producer that enumerates the requested matching entries already exposes their count; no redundant compute/entries node is part of the intent graph.
decisions_applied.case_038: Temporarily outside_registry; reconsider only after a reviewed invoice/PDF discovery, reading and structured-extraction pipeline exists.
decisions_applied.case_084: The complete graph is the single get/images operation.
decisions_applied.case_113: Selecting or renaming fields already present in structured records is projection, not a separate extraction operation.

cases.query_text: a chi assomiglia la persona in questa foto?

resolution.evidence: find/persons maps to find_persons_indices, whose reference_images mode performs face similarity; get/persons only lists or looks up records in the enrolled-person registry.

cases.query_text: a chi assomiglia la persona in questa foto

resolution.evidence: This is the punctuation variant of case 9: the request is a similarity search from a photo, not a registry listing or name lookup.

cases.query_text: quante email di spam ho ricevuto nella mailbox knowcastle

resolution.evidence: read/messages enumerates the messages matching account and folder criteria and exposes the resulting entry count. compute/entries would redundantly recount the producer output rather than add requested meaning.

cases.query_text: trova le issue aperte di brunialti/metnos su GitHub, salva nello store github_issue_qa quelle nuove non ancora presenti e dimmi quante issue nuove hai inserito.

resolution.evidence: The registry has no operation for the named github_issue_qa store. read/files and write/files are local-filesystem operations and cannot stand in for a logical store; persistence and delta comparison are indispensable, so the whole compound is outside_registry.

cases.query_text: cerca tutte fatture anthropic e metti data e importo su spreadsheet

resolution.evidence: The indispensable extraction of invoice date and amount is not represented by a reviewed route, so the temporary classification is outside_registry even though the source is also underspecified.
resolution.future_note: Revisit after a reviewed end-to-end pipeline exists for locating invoices, including PDF invoices, reading them, extracting date and amount, and creating the spreadsheet.

cases.query_text: leggi i file readme su github brunialti/metnos e cerca sul web notizie su python

resolution.evidence: The registered find/files and read/files implementations cover the local filesystem, not repository contents on GitHub. The web-news clause is representable, but the indispensable GitHub README clause is not, so no partial graph is retained.

cases.query_text: Cerca nello store github_issue_qa le entries con campo status uguale a 'approved', poi posta su GitHub il campo accepted_reply come commento della rispettiva issue del repo brunialti/metnos, infine scrivi nello store github_issue_qa quelle entries con campo status uguale a 'posted'

resolution.evidence: send/messages covers posting GitHub comments, but the required read and state update of github_issue_qa have no store operation in the registry. Local read/files and write/files do not preserve that object, so the whole compound is outside_registry.

cases.query_text: Elenca le issue aperte di brunialti/metnos su github e salvale nello store github_issue_qa

resolution.evidence: find/issues covers the source, but the named store sink is not registered and is not equivalent to write/files. Because saving is indispensable, the complete request is outside_registry.

cases.query_text: leggi le issue aperte su github di brunialti/metnos e salvale nel database locale come pending

resolution.evidence: The registry can find GitHub issues but has no operation for inserting or updating records in a local database. write/files is a filesystem write, not a database mutation, so the indispensable sink makes the compound outside_registry.

cases.query_text: Cerca nello store github_issue_qa le issue con status uguale a 'answered', chiedi la mia approvazione, pubblica il commento su github e aggiorna lo status a 'posted'

resolution.evidence: The approval barrier and GitHub comment are registered, but reading and updating github_issue_qa are indispensable unregistered store operations. A barrier cannot make an outside-registry object representable; the whole request is outside_registry.

cases.query_text: Elenca i corpus che hanno un indice immagini unificato e mostra quante foto contiene ciascuno

resolution.evidence: get/images maps to get_images_indices, whose current contract discovers every materialized unified corpus index when base_path is omitted and returns base_path plus n_entries per corpus. find/dirs is neither needed nor specific to indexed corpora.

cases.query_text: leggi il file README.md dal repo github brunialti/metnos

resolution.evidence: read/files reads local filesystem paths and exposes only the local client. The frozen registry has no GitHub repository-file reader, so provider qualification cannot be treated as an argument to this route.

The user names a public web page and asks only to read it. read/urls covers deterministic HTML reading of a known public URL; no login, persistent browser session or interactive site action is requested.

cases.query_text: leggi i file readme su github e cerca sul web notizie su python

resolution.evidence: The registry has no operation for finding and reading repository files on GitHub; local find/files and read/files cannot substitute for it. The web-search clause is representable, but the indispensable GitHub clause makes the complete compound outside_registry.

cases.query_text: trova le issue aperte di brunialti/metnos su GitHub, salva nello store github_issue_qa quelle nuove con status new

resolution.evidence: The issue discovery is registered, but comparison with and persistence into github_issue_qa, including setting status new, require an unregistered named-store operation. Filesystem routes do not preserve that meaning, so the whole compound is outside_registry.

cases.query_text: elenca tutti i file su github nel repo brunialti/metnos

resolution.evidence: list/dirs lists a local directory and has no GitHub provider. The registry contains issue and pull-request routes for GitHub but no repository-tree or repository-file listing route.

cases.query_text: cosa c'e' scritto nella pagina di booking.com

resolution.evidence: Like case 97, this asks for public page content at a named domain. read/urls preserves that read-only meaning; nothing requests authentication, navigation state or interaction.

cases.query_text: leggi gli eventi di questa settimana, estrai titolo e orario e crea un foglio di calcolo

resolution.evidence: read/events already returns structured event records containing title and time fields. Selecting or renaming those fields is projection into create/files, not a missing extraction operation; the spreadsheet consumes the upstream records.
